content: Next.js Data Cache (per-fetch, via next.revalidate) remains a fully supported, separate cache layer in Next.js 16 even without Cache Components enabled. fetch() matches cache entries on URL+method+headers+body, so 13 distinct feed URLs get 13 distinct cache entries. Time-based revalidation triggers stale-while-revalidate (x-vercel-cache: STALE / reason stale_time) — visitors get the last-good cached response immediately while regeneration happens in background. Confirmed directly via nextjs.org/docs (updated 2026-08-25) and vercel.com/docs/caching/runtime-cache/data-cache (updated 2026-08-21).
